repos.name: bitwarden/agent-access
repos.description: Agent Access is an open protocol, CLI tool, and SDK to provide agents with credentials without exposing their entire vault
repos.one_liner: An open protocol and SDK designed to provide AI agents with secure, granular access to credentials without exposing an entire vault.
bullets: Built in Rust for high-performance, memory-safe credential management.
Implements a secure protocol to bridge the gap between static secret storage and dynamic agentic workflows.
Enables fine-grained permission scoping for AI agents, preventing over-privileged access to sensitive infrastructure.
Essential for enterprise-grade AI agents requiring automated authentication to fintech or cloud services.

repos.name: n8n-io/n8n
repos.description: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host or cloud, 400+ integrations.
repos.one_liner: A powerful, fair-code workflow automation platform that integrates AI capabilities with over 400 services.
bullets: TypeScript-based engine supporting both visual node-based workflows and custom JavaScript/Python code execution.
Native AI integration allows for complex agentic orchestration and LLM-driven decision making within business processes.
Highly flexible deployment options including self-hosting for strict data privacy and compliance requirements.
Ideal for automating fintech back-office operations, data reconciliation, and multi-platform API orchestration.

repos.name: aoci-spec/aoci-code
repos.description: A persistent, Git-versioned map of your whole codebase and database schema that coding agents read before they touch anything. Local-first MCP server + CLI in Go: a governed repository index of code knowledge that gives Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and opencode long-term context, memory, and code intelligence.
repos.one_liner: A local-first MCP server and CLI tool that provides coding agents with a governed, Git-versioned index of codebase and database schemas.
bullets: Go-based architecture providing a high-performance, persistent map of complex software repositories.
Acts as a context-provider for AI agents, ensuring they have accurate, up-to-date knowledge of database schemas and code structure.
Implements a governed indexing system to prevent agents from hallucinating or misinterpreting codebase dependencies.
Streamlines the development lifecycle by providing agents with a structured 'source of truth' before executing code changes.

repos.name: openvinotoolkit/openvino
repos.description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
repos.one_liner: An industry-standard toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference across diverse hardware architectures.
bullets: C++ core with Python bindings, optimized for high-throughput, low-latency AI model execution.
Supports model quantization, pruning, and hardware-specific acceleration for edge and cloud deployment.
Critical infrastructure for running LLMs and predictive models locally or on-premise without relying on external APIs.
Widely used in quant finance and real-time analytics to reduce inference costs and latency for time-series forecasting.

repos.name: HKUDS/PhoneCLI
repos.one_liner: A framework designed to make mobile applications 'agent-native' by enabling AI control over mobile interfaces.
bullets: Python-based framework that bridges the gap between LLM reasoning and mobile UI interaction.
Enables agents to navigate, click, and input data into mobile apps, facilitating automated testing and user-flow simulation.
Provides a standardized interface for agents to interact with mobile environments, bypassing traditional API limitations.
Useful for automating mobile-first fintech workflows, such as expense tracking, banking verification, or automated UI regression testing.
